name: Viridian Forest
summary: Canopy maze between Viridian City and Pewter City. Prime spot for fast early evolutions (Butterfree & Beedrill at Lv. 10) and Electric coverage.

items.name: Antidote
items.method: On the bottom left, in a patch of grass

items.name: Poké Ball
items.method: On the bottom right, in a patch of grass

items.name: Potion
items.method: Central forest clearing beside Youngster Sean

items.name: Pecha Berry
items.method: Given by Youngster Sean after defeat / hidden in tree

Spider Webs.name: Spinarak
Spider Webs.rates: 33% Daily Interaction (also Pecha Berries & Bug Gems)

In-Game Trade.name: Caterpie/Zubat or Weedle/Zubat
In-Game Trade.rates: Bug Catcher Rick (Trades for any Bug-type)

move_tutors.name: Bug Bite Move Tutor
move_tutors.location: Inside the exit gate leading from Viridian Forest to Route 2 (After Forest) / Pewter City
move_tutors.notes: Teaches 60 BP Bug physical move Bug Bite (steals and consumes opponent's held berry).

navigation_notes: Interact with spider webs for Spinarak and mushrooms for Paras. Bug Catcher Rick trades a spliced Zubat hybrid for any wild Bug. Collect 3 Tiny Mushrooms from the forest floor for the Pewter Hotel stew quest.
